questions.explanation: 作者在电脑上飞快打字，面临专栏截稿和新书修改的紧迫期限，因此丈夫观察到她的状态是“压力大的(stressed)”。
questions.supplement:
A(upset)：语境句：She felt upset about losing her favorite watch. 固定搭配：be upset about, feel upset
B(stressed)：语境句：Many students feel stressed before their final exams. 固定搭配：feel stressed, stressed out
C(productive)：语境句：We had a highly productive meeting this morning. 固定搭配：highly productive, a productive member
D(focused)：语境句：He remained completely focused on his experiment. 固定搭配：stay focused, highly focused

questions.explanation: 根据后文的“due next week”和“tight deadlines”可知，作者有一个报纸专栏需要很快“完成(finish)”。
questions.supplement:
A(finish)：语境句：I need to finish my homework before going out. 固定搭配：finish doing sth, finish up
B(design)：语境句：The architect was asked to design a new museum. 固定搭配：design a plan, graphic design
C(report)：语境句：The committee will report its findings next week. 固定搭配：report on, it is reported that
D(read)：语境句：She loves to read novels in her spare time. 固定搭配：read about, read between the lines

questions.explanation: 由于工作确实很多且期限紧，作者无法“否认(deny)”丈夫说她看起来压力很大的话。
questions.supplement:
A(believe)：语境句：I firmly believe that hard work pays off. 固定搭配：believe in, make believe
B(understand)：语境句：It is easy to understand why she was so angry. 固定搭配：fully understand, understand exactly
C(forget)：语境句：Don't forget to lock the door when you leave. 固定搭配：forget to do sth, forget doing sth
D(deny)：语境句：The suspect refused to deny the accusations against him. 固定搭配：deny doing sth, there is no denying that

questions.explanation: 丈夫提议去大烟山露营，目的是“逃离/远离(get away from)”繁忙的城市生活。
questions.supplement:
A(move on to)：语境句：After discussing the budget, let's move on to the next topic. 固定搭配：move on to sth/doing sth
B(get away from)：语境句：He took a vacation to get away from the pressures of work. 固定搭配：get away from it all, get away from reality
C(keep up with)：语境句：She walked so fast that I couldn't keep up with her. 固定搭配：keep up with the times, keep up with peers
D(look back on)：语境句：Old people often look back on their youth with nostalgia. 固定搭配：look back on the past, look back on memories

questions.explanation: 前文提到去野外露营，结合“There had been a time”和转折词“But now who has time?”，说明作者过去曾非常“渴望(eager)”去野外度周末。
questions.supplement:
A(proud)：语境句：His parents are very proud of his academic achievements. 固定搭配：be proud of, take pride in
B(satisfied)：语境句：The customer was completely satisfied with the service. 固定搭配：be satisfied with, highly satisfied
C(eager)：语境句：The fans were eager to meet the famous actor. 固定搭配：be eager for, be eager to do sth
D(relieved)：语境句：I felt relieved when I heard they arrived safely. 固定搭配：feel relieved, be relieved to hear

questions.explanation: 作者以“赶最后期限”为由推托，但丈夫不接受她的任何“借口(excuse)”。
questions.supplement:
A(apology)：语境句：He owes me a sincere apology for his rude behavior. 固定搭配：make an apology, accept an apology
B(consequence)：语境句：You must be responsible for the consequence of your actions. 固定搭配：as a consequence, face the consequences
C(excuse)：语境句：There is no excuse for being late to the interview. 固定搭配：make an excuse, a good excuse
D(instruction)：语境句：Please read the instruction carefully before using the machine. 固定搭配：follow instructions, give instructions

questions.explanation: 刚整理完营地，作者立刻/迫不及待地(instantly)打开手机，因为她一直惦记着工作。
questions.supplement:
A(rarely)：语境句：She rarely goes out at night because it's unsafe. 固定搭配：rarely ever, very rarely
B(consistently)：语境句：The restaurant has consistently provided excellent food. 固定搭配：perform consistently, consistently high
C(hesitantly)：语境句：He stepped forward hesitantly, unsure of what to say. 固定搭配：speak hesitantly, smile hesitantly
D(instantly)：语境句：The pain disappeared instantly after I took the medicine. 固定搭配：recognize instantly, react instantly

questions.explanation: 好几个小时没看消息了，作者担心自己可能“错过(missed)”了紧急的事情。
questions.supplement:
A(missed)：语境句：I missed the early bus and was late for work. 固定搭配：miss the chance, miss the point
B(ignored)：语境句：He ignored the warning signs and continued driving. 固定搭配：be totally ignored, deliberately ignore
C(recorded)：语境句：The historian recorded the events in great detail. 固定搭配：be officially recorded, record a video
D(conveyed)：语境句：Words cannot fully convey my gratitude to you. 固定搭配：convey a message, convey meaning

questions.explanation: 手机没信号，作者觉得没带笔记本电脑继续写作真是一个“遗憾(pity)”。
questions.supplement:
A(chance)：语境句：This is a rare chance to study abroad. 固定搭配：by chance, take a chance
B(reason)：语境句：Give me one good reason why I should believe you. 固定搭配：for some reason, the reason for
C(pity)：语境句：It's a pity that you couldn't attend the party. 固定搭配：what a pity, feel pity for
D(surprise)：语境句：Her sudden resignation came as a total surprise. 固定搭配：to one's surprise, in surprise

questions.explanation: 根据后文“not knowing how to kill time”可知，作者有一阵子感到“不知所措(at a loss)”。
questions.supplement:
A(in a hurry)：语境句：He left in a hurry and forgot his keys. 固定搭配：in a hurry to do, be in no hurry
B(at a loss)：语境句：I was completely at a loss for words when I heard the news. 固定搭配：at a loss what to do, feel at a loss
C(on purpose)：语境句：I didn't break the glass on purpose; it was an accident. 固定搭配：do sth on purpose
D(under control)：语境句：The firefighters quickly brought the blaze under control. 固定搭配：keep under control, get sth under control

questions.explanation: 作者当下觉得无聊，但丈夫保证到了晚上情况就会“不同(different)”。
questions.supplement:
A(familiar)：语境句：The stranger's voice sounded strangely familiar. 固定搭配：be familiar with, be familiar to
B(normal)：语境句：It is normal to feel nervous before giving a speech. 固定搭配：return to normal, absolutely normal
C(smooth)：语境句：The transition to the new system was quite smooth. 固定搭配：smooth out, smooth progress
D(different)：语境句：My opinion is completely different from yours. 固定搭配：be different from, think different

questions.explanation: 夜幕降临，作者和丈夫“跟随(followed)”观赏萤火虫的队伍前往观赏点。
questions.supplement:
A(informed)：语境句：We will keep you informed of any new developments. 固定搭配：inform sb of sth, stay informed
B(followed)：语境句：The little dog followed the boy wherever he went. 固定搭配：follow the rules, follow someone's advice
C(assisted)：语境句：The senior doctor assisted the surgeon during the operation. 固定搭配：assist sb with sth, assist in doing sth
D(influenced)：语境句：His writing style was heavily influenced by classical literature. 固定搭配：be influenced by, greatly influence

questions.explanation: 萤火虫成千上万，甚至上百万，根本不可能把它们全都“数清(count)”。
questions.supplement:
A(count)：语境句：She tried to count the stars in the night sky. 固定搭配：count on, count down
B(enjoy)：语境句：I hope you enjoy your stay at our hotel. 固定搭配：enjoy oneself, enjoy doing sth
C(protect)：语境句：We must take action to protect the environment. 固定搭配：protect from, protect against
D(catch)：语境句：He ran as fast as he could to catch the train. 固定搭配：catch a cold, catch one's eye

questions.explanation: 萤火虫像灯一样闪烁几秒钟，然后“消失(disappeared)”，几秒后再次闪烁。
questions.supplement:
A(gathered)：语境句：A large crowd gathered outside the city hall. 固定搭配：gather around, gather information
B(increased)：语境句：The price of oil has increased significantly this year. 固定搭配：increase by, increase in
C(disappeared)：语境句：The magician waved his wand, and the rabbit disappeared. 固定搭配：disappear from sight, completely disappear
D(performed)：语境句：The band performed live in front of a huge audience. 固定搭配：perform well, perform a task

questions.explanation: 后文说“世界安静了下来，久违的放松又回来了”，说明作者内心充满了“平静(Peace)”。
questions.supplement:
A(Warmth)：语境句：I could feel the warmth of the sun on my face. 固定搭配：inner warmth, human warmth
B(Optimism)：语境句：Despite the difficulties, she faced the future with optimism. 固定搭配：cautious optimism, full of optimism
C(Hope)：语境句：We must never give up hope, even in the darkest times. 固定搭配：in the hope of, give up hope
D(Peace)：语境句：After years of war, the country finally achieved peace. 固定搭配：inner peace, in peace

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling worried and anxious
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作系动词look的表语，表示状态。原文中"You look stressed"，look是系动词，stressed描述主语you的状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: She looks stressed because of the upcoming exam.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她因为即将到来的考试看起来很焦虑。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a regular article in a newspaper written by a particular writer
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作had的宾语，单数形式。原文中"I had a newspaper column to finish soon"。
vocab_pack.example_en: She writes a weekly newspaper column about fashion.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她每周写一篇关于时尚的报纸专栏。

vocab_pack.definition_en: expected or scheduled to happen or be done
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作后置定语修饰book，表示书的下周到期。原文中"changes in a book due next week"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project is due next Friday.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个项目下周五到期。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say that something is not true or refuse to admit something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词couldn't后接动词原形deny。原文中"I couldn't deny his words"。
vocab_pack.example_en: He couldn't deny that he had made a mistake.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他无法否认自己犯了错误。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spend a holiday living in a tent or camper
vocab_pack.grammar_note: go + 动名词表示进行某活动。原文中"Let's go camping"为祈使句，go是动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: We plan to go camping next weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们计划下周末去露营。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to escape from a place or situation, especially to have a break
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，get是动词原形。原文中"get away from city life"表示远离城市生活。
vocab_pack.example_en: I need to get away from work for a few days.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我需要离开工作几天。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: There had been a time when
vocab_pack.definition_en: used to indicate that something existed or happened in the past
vocab_pack.grammar_note: there be句型，过去完成时had been表示过去的过去。原文中"There had been a time when I was eager…"。
vocab_pack.example_en: There was a time when I enjoyed running every morning.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 曾经有一段时间我喜欢每天早上跑步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: There had been a time when

vocab_pack.definition_en: wanting very much to do or have something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，后接不定式to spend。原文中"I was eager to spend a weekend"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children are eager to open their presents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们急切地想打开礼物。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to work under severe time constraints
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 在紧迫的截止日期下工作
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在进行时，working是work的现在分词。原文中"I'm working to tight deadlines"。
vocab_pack.example_en: She often works to tight deadlines to meet client expectations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她经常在紧迫的截止日期下工作以满足客户期望。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to believe or allow a reason given for doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时否定，didn't accept后接动词原形accept。原文中"George didn't accept any excuse"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The manager won't accept any excuse for being late.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经理不会接受任何迟到的借口。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say yes to something; to consent
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，agreed是agree的过去式。原文中"Finally, I agreed"。
vocab_pack.example_en: After much discussion, she agreed to the plan.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经过大量讨论，她同意了这个计划。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reach a place before the expected time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，arrived是arrive的过去式。原文中"We arrived early on Saturday morning"。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is polite to arrive early for an interview.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 面试时早到是有礼貌的。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to unlock and start using one's mobile phone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，opened是open的过去式。原文中"I instantly opened my phone"。
vocab_pack.example_en: He opened his phone to check the time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他打开手机看时间。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have finished doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: be done后接动名词，表示完成动作。原文中"after we were done tidying the campsite"，were是be的过去式。
vocab_pack.example_en: Once you are done eating, please clear the table.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你吃完后请清理桌子。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make the camping area neat and clean
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作be done的补足成分。原文中"tidying the campsite"是动名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We should tidy the campsite before leaving.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 离开前我们应该整理露营地。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to look at one's text messages or emails
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，checked是check的过去式。原文中"since I checked messages"（since从句用一般过去时）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I always check messages before going to bed.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我总是在睡觉前查看信息。

vocab_pack.definition_en: requiring immediate action or attention
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作后置定语修饰不定代词something。原文中"something urgent"。
vocab_pack.example_en: There is an urgent message for you.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 有你一条紧急信息。

vocab_pack.definition_en: used to express regret about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去时，it作形式主语，that引导主语从句。原文中"It was a pity that I didn't take my laptop"。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is a pity that you missed the concert.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 真遗憾你错过了音乐会。

vocab_pack.definition_en: confused and not knowing what to do
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作表语，与be动词连用。原文中"I was at a loss"。
vocab_pack.example_en: He was at a loss for words when he heard the news.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 听到消息时他不知该说什么。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to spend time doing something unimportant while waiting
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，kill是动词原形。原文中"how to kill time"为疑问词+不定式结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: I read a magazine to kill time while waiting for the bus.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我等公交车时看杂志消磨时间。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to ask someone to go somewhere social with you
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，invited是invite的过去式，后接代词me。原文中"George invited me out"。
vocab_pack.example_en: He invited her out for a coffee.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他邀请她出去喝咖啡。

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: assured me things would be different
vocab_pack.definition_en: to tell someone that something is definitely true or will happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，assured是assure的过去式，后接间接宾语me和that从句（省略that）。原文中"assured me things would be different"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor assured her that the operation would be safe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生向她保证手术会是安全的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: assured me things would be different

vocab_pack.definition_en: the time of day when it becomes dark
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词作主语。原文中"As nightfall came"。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must reach the camp before nightfall.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须在黄昏前到达营地。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go or travel towards a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作伴随状语，making是make的现在分词。原文中"making our way to the viewing spot"。
vocab_pack.example_en: We made our way through the crowded street.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们穿过拥挤的街道。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a place where one can watch or observe something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语作宾语。原文中"to the viewing spot"。
vocab_pack.example_en: This is the best viewing spot for the sunset.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这是观看日落的最佳地点。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give out light
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，shone是shine的过去式。原文中"Fireflies shone among trees"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The stars shone brightly in the sky.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 星星在天空中明亮地闪耀。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to shine brightly for a short time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，flashed是flash的过去式。原文中"They flashed like lights for seconds"。
vocab_pack.example_en: Lightning flashed across the sky.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 闪电划过天空。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear or arrive, often unexpectedly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，turned up是turn up的过去式。原文中"they turned up flashing again"。
vocab_pack.example_en: He turned up late for the meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他开会迟到了。

vocab_pack.definition_en: not moving; quiet and calm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作主语补足语（描述主语的状态），与sat连用。原文中"I sat completely still"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The children sat still during the story.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 孩子们讲故事时一动不动地坐着。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move continuously and smoothly through something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，flowed是flow的过去式。原文中"Peace flowed through me"。
vocab_pack.example_en: A sense of calm flowed through her body.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 一种平静的感觉流过她的身体。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become quiet or calmer
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，quieted是quiet的过去式。原文中"the world quieted down"。
vocab_pack.example_en: The audience quieted down as the speaker began.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 演讲者开始时，观众安静了下来。

vocab_pack.definition_en: greatly missed for a long time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词作定语修饰relaxation。原文中"the long-missed relaxation"。
vocab_pack.example_en: After years abroad, he enjoyed the long-missed taste of home.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 在国外多年后，他享受到了久违的家乡味道。

section_2_word_form.passage:
Imagine boarding a plane and flying 1,600 miles across the ocean to a new country. That was my experience three years ago when I, supported by my family, [56] (begin) my learning journey in an academic institution in China. Professors and students there genuinely care about one another, resulting [57] a strong feeling of cooperation and building a [58] (harmony) community where students work toward a clear purpose. I remember [59] (motivate) by the quality of my classmates' work, in a good manner.
Moreover, [60] appeals to me is that there are societies for any passion students may have, allowing students of all interests and backgrounds to express [61] (they) fully. Personally, I enjoy the “Tea Tasting” event the most, which is different from those in my country. When it comes to foreigners drinking tea, the [62] (major) of them simply add tea leaves to hot water, and drink it if it tastes fine.
Since the event kicked off, I [63] (gain) some insights into Chinese tea culture by knowing the way to “taste” tea, the reason why Chinese people enjoy drinking tea, [64] the mood they have when drinking tea. Besides being a continuation of traditional Chinese culture, tea can also serve as a way to relax in a busy life, enabling the spirit, body, and mind [65] (slow) down.

questions.explanation: 时间状语为“three years ago”，故此处应使用一般过去时。
questions.supplement: 正确形(began)：语境句：The meeting began with a brief introduction. 固定搭配：began with, began to do. 原词begin其它变形：beginner (n.), beginning (n.). 常见搭配：to begin with, begin a new life.

questions.explanation: 固定搭配result in，意为“导致，造成”，这里指互相关心导致了强烈的合作感。
questions.supplement: 正确形(in)：语境句：His reckless driving resulted in a serious accident. 固定搭配：result in, participate in. 原词其它搭配：result from (由...引起), as a result.

questions.explanation: 修饰名词community，需要使用形容词形式harmonious，意为“和谐的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(harmonious)：语境句：They have managed to maintain a harmonious relationship. 固定搭配：a harmonious society, a harmonious relationship. 原词harmony其它变形：harmonize (v.), harmoniously (adv.). 常见搭配：in harmony with.

questions.explanation: remember doing sth意为“记得做过某事”；主语I和motivate之间是被动关系（被同学的高质量作业所激励），故用动名词的被动式being motivated。
questions.supplement: 正确形(being motivated)：语境句：He recalled being motivated by his teacher's encouraging words. 固定搭配：remember being done, enjoy being done. 原词motivate其它变形：motivation (n.), motivated (adj.). 常见搭配：highly motivated, motivate sb to do sth.

questions.explanation: 引导主语从句，并在从句中作主语，表示“……的事物”，用what。
questions.supplement: 正确形(what)：语境句：What surprised me most was her positive attitude. 固定搭配：what's more, what matters most. 其它常见引导词辨析：that (不充当成分), which (有范围限制的选择).

questions.explanation: allow students to express...，主语是students，动作的承受者也是他们自己，故用反身代词themselves表示“表达自我”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(themselves)：语境句：The children enjoyed themselves at the amusement park. 固定搭配：express themselves, by themselves. 原词they其它变形：their (adj.), theirs (pron.), them (pron.). 常见搭配：help themselves to.

questions.explanation: the majority of为固定短语，意为“大多数的……”。此处需用名词形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(majority)：语境句：The vast majority of people supported the new policy. 固定搭配：the majority of, a clear majority. 原词major其它变形：majority (n.). 常见搭配：major in (主修), play a major role.

questions.explanation: 句子由“Since...”引导的时间状语从句修饰，主句通常需要用现在完成时，表示从过去一直持续到现在的动作或影响。
questions.supplement: 正确形(have gained)：语境句：Since I started this job, I have gained a lot of valuable experience. 固定搭配：have gained popularity, have gained insight. 原词gain其它变形：gains (n.复数). 常见搭配：gain weight, no pain no gain.

questions.explanation: 此处并列三个名词短语：the way..., the reason..., 以及 the mood...，用并列连词and连接。
questions.supplement: 正确形(and)：语境句：He bought some apples, bananas, and oranges. 固定搭配：both... and..., and so on. 其它常见并列连词：or, but, yet.

questions.explanation: 固定搭配enable sb/sth to do sth，意为“使某人/某物能够做某事”，需带to的不定式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to slow)：语境句：The new software will enable the system to slow down its power consumption. 固定搭配：enable sb to do, start to slow down. 原词slow其它变形：slowly (adv.), slowness (n.). 常见搭配：slow down, slow but sure.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to get on a plane
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作动词 imagine 的宾语；board 为及物动词，后直接接 a plane。
vocab_pack.example_en: I will board a plane to Shanghai tomorrow.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我明天将登上去上海的飞机。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Imagine boarding a plane and flying 1,600 miles across the ocean

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive help or encouragement from someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 supported 构成被动语态，与 by 连用表示施动者；句中作伴随状语（I, supported by my family, began...）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am supported by my family in my studies.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我在学业上受到家人的支持。
vocab_pack.from_passage: when I, supported by my family, began my learning journey

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语 I，谓语用过去式 began，表示过去开始的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: She began learning English three years ago.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她三年前开始学英语。
vocab_pack.from_passage: began my learning journey in an academic institution in China

vocab_pack.definition_en: a school, college, or university
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 学术机构（学校、学院或大学）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定冠词 an 修饰，表示泛指；在句中作介词 in 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He studied at a prestigious academic institution.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他在一所著名的学术机构学习。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in an academic institution in China

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be concerned about someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 Professors and students 复数，谓语用原形 care；about 后接宾语 one another。
vocab_pack.example_en: They care about each other's well-being.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们关心彼此的福祉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Professors and students there genuinely care about one another

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause a particular situation to happen
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词短语作结果状语，相当于 and results in；主语是前句所述情况。
vocab_pack.example_en: Hard work results in success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 努力带来成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: resulting in a strong feeling of cooperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: the act of working together with others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，此处作介词 of 的宾语，与 feeling 搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: Cooperation between departments is essential.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 部门之间的合作至关重要。

vocab_pack.definition_en: friendly, peaceful, and without disagreement
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作定语修饰 community；由名词 harmony 派生而来。
vocab_pack.example_en: They aim to build a harmonious society.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们旨在建设和谐社会。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try to achieve something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 students 复数，谓语用原形 work；toward 为介词，后接名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We work toward a common goal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们朝着共同的目标努力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: where students work toward a clear purpose

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone want to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 motived 构成被动语态，与 by 连用表示被某人/某物激励；此处为 being motivated（动名词被动形式）。
vocab_pack.example_en: I am motivated by the success of my peers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我受到同龄人成功的激励。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I remember being motivated by the quality of my classmates' work

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a positive or respectful way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作方式状语，修饰整个句子，表示以好的方式被激励。
vocab_pack.example_en: She always behaves in a good manner.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她总是举止得体。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to attract or interest someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 what 为第三人称单数，谓语用 appeals；to 后接宾语 me。
vocab_pack.example_en: This music appeals to young people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种音乐吸引年轻人。
vocab_pack.from_passage: what appeals to me is that

vocab_pack.definition_en: a club or organization for people with shared interests
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词复数形式，作 there are 的主语，泛指各类社团。
vocab_pack.example_en: There are many societies at university.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大学里有很多社团。
vocab_pack.from_passage: there are societies for any passion students may have

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show your feelings, thoughts, or ideas
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语，allowing ... to do 结构；themselves 为反身代词，对应主语 students。
vocab_pack.example_en: Students should be allowed to express themselves freely.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 应该允许学生自由表达自己。
vocab_pack.from_passage: allowing students of all interests and backgrounds to express themselves fully

vocab_pack.definition_en: an event where people taste and evaluate different teas
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 专有名词，首字母大写，作 event 的同位语或事件名称；此处指特定活动。
vocab_pack.example_en: I attended a tea tasting event last weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 上周末我参加了一个品茶活动。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I enjoy the “Tea Tasting” event the most

vocab_pack.definition_en: not the same as someone or something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词短语作表语，后接 those 代指事件，表示与本国事件不同。
vocab_pack.example_en: This book is different from that one.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这本书与那本不同。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which is different from those in my country

vocab_pack.definition_en: concerning; when talking about
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 固定搭配，后接名词/动名词；句中 When it comes to foreigners drinking tea 是时间状语从句的简化形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: When it comes to learning English, practice is key.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 说到学英语，练习是关键。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When it comes to foreigners drinking tea

vocab_pack.definition_en: most of; more than half of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 后接复数名词或代词，谓语动词用复数（句中 add 为复数形式）；of them 限定范围。
vocab_pack.example_en: The majority of students agree with the plan.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 大多数学生同意这个计划。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the majority of them simply add tea leaves to hot water

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: add tea leaves to hot water
vocab_pack.definition_en: to put something into something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 the majority of them 复数，谓语用原形 add；to 表示添加的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: Please add sugar to your coffee.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 请在你的咖啡里加糖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: simply add tea leaves to hot water

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have a particular flavor
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 系动词，后接形容词 fine 作表语；一般现在时，主语 it 第三人称单数，谓语用 tastes。
vocab_pack.example_en: The soup tastes delicious.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这汤尝起来很美味。
vocab_pack.from_passage: and drink it if it tastes fine

vocab_pack.definition_en: to start (an event or activity)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，主语 the event 单数，谓语用过去式 kicked off；固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: The festival kicked off with a parade.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 节日以游行开始。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to obtain a deep understanding
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，主语 I，have + 过去分词 gained；insights 为可数名词复数，some 修饰。
vocab_pack.example_en: I have gained insights into Chinese history through this book.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过这本书，我对中国历史有了深入的了解。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I have gained some insights into Chinese tea culture

vocab_pack.definition_en: the method or manner of doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: the way + 不定式表示方法；句中 the way to 'taste' tea 作 knowing 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Learn the way to cook traditional dishes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学习烹饪传统菜肴的方法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: by knowing the way to “taste” tea

vocab_pack.definition_en: the explanation or cause for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: the reason why 后接从句（此处 why Chinese people enjoy drinking tea 为定语从句），作 knowing 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Tell me the reason why you were late.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 告诉我你迟到的原因。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the reason why Chinese people enjoy drinking tea

vocab_pack.definition_en: the way you feel at a particular time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 定冠词 the 限定，后接定语从句 they have；作 have 的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: He is in a good mood today.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他今天心情很好。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the mood they have when drinking tea

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that continues or extends something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作介词 Besides 的宾语；a continuation of 结构。
vocab_pack.example_en: This festival is a continuation of an ancient tradition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日是古老传统的延续。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Besides being a continuation of traditional Chinese culture

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: serve as a way to relax
vocab_pack.definition_en: to function or act as something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 情态动词 can 后接原形 serve；as 为介词，后接名词短语 a way to relax。
vocab_pack.example_en: This room can serve as a study.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个房间可以用作书房。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tea can also serve as a way to relax in a busy life

vocab_pack.form_in_passage: enabling the spirit, body, and mind to slow down
vocab_pack.definition_en: to make it possible for someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 enabling 作伴随状语，表示结果；enable + 宾语（the spirit, body, and mind）+ 不定式 to slow down。
vocab_pack.example_en: Regular exercise enables you to stay healthy.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 经常锻炼能使你保持健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: enabling the spirit, body, and mind to slow down

vocab_pack.definition_en: to reduce speed or relax
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to slow down 作宾语补足语；slow 为动词原形，down 为副词。
vocab_pack.example_en: You need to slow down and rest.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你需要慢下来休息一下。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a lifestyle that involves many activities and little free time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定冠词 a 修饰，作 in 的宾语；busy 为形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: She leads a busy life as a doctor.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她作为一名医生过着忙碌的生活。
vocab_pack.from_passage: a way to relax in a busy life

vocab_pack.definition_en: the three aspects of a person: spiritual, physical, and mental
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 定冠词 the 修饰三个并列名词，作 enabling 的宾语；表示整体概念。
vocab_pack.example_en: Yoga benefits the spirit, body, and mind.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 瑜伽有益于精神、身体和心灵。
vocab_pack.from_passage: enabling the spirit, body, and mind to slow down
